description: Labelled intent-routing cases for evaluating the local decision sidecar against deterministic routing.

provenanceLevels.model-authored: Case text and label written by a model. Sufficient for smoke signal, NOT sufficient for a promotion gate.
provenanceLevels.human-labelled: Case text drawn from real usage and labelled by a maintainer. Required for promotion evidence.
provenanceLevels.history-derived: Case text extracted from recorded routing history, label confirmed by a maintainer.

promotionRequires.note: confident-wrong is the safety metric: a wrong selection at or above the policy probability threshold. Accuracy alone never justifies promotion.
